reason: All exercised behavior falls within supported constructs: first-class functions passed, returned, cast from any and narrowed from unions; anonymous functions and captured-variable mutation; structurally compatible class parameter subtyping; bound method values retaining receivers and rest arguments; and a default function-valued parameter on a known function declaration.
